text:
sara: Posting consolidated action items from last night's token-validation outage. TL;DR: root cause = expired third-party signing key + missing canary for permission checks; audit logs didn't include user_id for 3 token endpoints. Draft postmortem attached: https://redwood/docs/postmortems/INC-2071-draft -- please read and ack. :rotating_light:

rahul: taking ownership of key-rotation automation. ETA EOD Thu for an initial CI job + dry-run. Will need a KMS role change. @mikayla can you add infra runbook link to the postmortem?

mikayla: ack — added runbook link and created a follow-up board card. Note: rotation script will need iam:Decrypt on the service account. Pushed a patch to the infra playbook.

emily: I'll own the audit-logging fix (emit request_id + user_id for /api/v1/token/*). Estimate 2 sprints but can try to compress to 1 sprint if we freeze noncritical prs. any objections? :thinking_face:

rahul: no objections. also proposing a canary gate so we fail closed if audit sentinel missing. I can add a Datadog alert and a tiny pre-deploy check. Example alert query I plan to push:

```
logs("service:auth AND source:token AND !user_id").index("*").rollup("count").last("5m") > 10
```

mikayla: that alert looks good. make sure it goes to #eng-oncall and creates a pager if it fires after deploy. I'll add a playbook snippet for runbook.

incident-bot: Reminder: assigned owners must acknowledge action items within 24h. Tracker card: https://redwood/tracker/INC-2071. Auto-reminder scheduled in 48h.

sara: Also adding rotation cadence change: monthly scheduled rotate with staged swap (keep old key active 48h). @ops please confirm on-prem rollout window and any compliance notes.

ops: Confirmed on-prem will follow same 30-day cadence. Need maintenance window on 2026-04-12 02:00-04:00 UTC for the staged swap. Will require customer notification for on-prem managed installs.

mikayla: follow-up checklist on board card (copied here): - [ ] PR: key rotation job + CI dry-run - [ ] KMS role/policy update - [ ] Audit events patch to include user_id - [ ] Canary alert + playbook - [ ] Runbook note about 48h staged swap

emily: quick question — rollback plan: do we keep the previous key for 48h and allow immediate revert? want this documented in runbook.

rahul: yes, rollback plan = staged swap with both keys valid for 48h; rotation script has a --staged flag. I'll document commands in the runbook and attach example: `scripts/rotate-keys --staged --verify`.

sara: Great. Assignments: rahul -> key rotation + alert, emily -> audit events, mikayla -> runbook + playbook + board owner, ops -> on-prem window & customer notice. If anyone needs help, shout here. Next sync: Fri 10:00 to surface blockers. Leaving this thread open for status updates. :calendar: :thumbsup:
